title: Anyone else noticed an uptick in Space N@z1s in Mall World recently?
content: I’ve had three dreams now, two in a row, one a couple days later, about a bunch of real pale, tall, humanoid folks with either white-blonde or black hair in black or tan uniforms being all over Mall World. As much fun as it’s been to spend the night dunking the shit out of them, I really do not need this kind of stress in my subconscious.
